geography: Worldwide (World column / Product Revenue as totalled by the issuer)
indication_area: Psychiatry (schizophrenia, bipolar disorder, adjunctive major depressive disorder)
moa: Atypical antipsychotic; dopamine D2 and serotonin 5-HT2A receptor antagonist

approval_evidence.quote: 05/17/2007 ORIG-1 Approval (NDA 022047, SEROQUEL XR QUETIAPINE FUMARATE)

launch_evidence.quote: The launch of Seroquel XR in the US took place in August 2007.

series_start_reason: Series starts 2009Q1, six quarters after the August 2007 US launch (2007Q3). Through the Q1 2010 announcement AstraZeneca printed only the combined 'Seroquel' line (IR plus XR); Seroquel XR first appears on its own line in the Q2 2010 announcement (filed 2010-08-09), whose summary table prints the Q2 2009 (157) and H1 2009 (283) prior-year figures. 2009Q2-2010Q1 are read from prior-year columns of the 2010 and Q1 2011 announcements and 2009Q1 is H1 2009 less Q2 2009. 2007Q3-2008Q4 are printed on sec.gov only inside the combined Seroquel line (the Q3 2007 announcement mentions 'around $80 million of stocking sales for the new Seroquel XR formulation' in prose), so they are not carried.
series_end_reason: The Q3 2018 announcement (Form 6-K filed 2018-11-08, a7037g.htm) is the last to print a 'Seroquel XR' row; from the FY and Q4 2018 announcement (Form 6-K filed 2019-02-14, a9540p.htm) onward AstraZeneca prints only the combined line 'Seroquel XR/IR', a different scope.
search_log: Listed AstraZeneca PLC (CIK 901832) filings via data.sec.gov submissions (2,057 filings, 1,620 of them Form 6-K). Located the quarterly results announcements with EDGAR full-text search restricted to CIK 901832 for each of 'Imjudo', 'Orpathys', 'Datroway' and 'Seroquel XR' (all forms, 2001-2026, yearly windows); every Form 6-K HTML hit was fetched from sec.gov (202 documents) and every table row parsed (bs4).

Quarter figure = World (first) column of the brand row in the regional 'Product Sales/Revenue analysis' table for the three months; the table's period is read from its header ('3 rd Quarter 2010 $m', 'Q3 2012 $m'). Cumulative (half-year, nine-month, full-year) tables are excluded by header.

Seroquel XR rows found as their own line in every quarterly announcement from Q2 2010 (2010-08-09) to Q3 2018 (2018-11-08); announcements from 2007 to Q1 2010 print only 'Seroquel'; from 2019-02-14 only 'Seroquel XR/IR'.

Full-year checks against the World column of the FY regional table: 2010: 256+303+279+316=1154 vs printed full-year 1154 OK; 2011: 339+387+366+398=1490 vs printed full-year 1490 OK; 2012: 384+370+373+382=1509 vs printed full-year 1509 OK; 2013: 322+339+339+337=1337 vs printed full-year 1337 OK; 2014: 292+304+319+309=1224 vs printed full-year 1224 OK; 2015: 262+264+258+241=1025 vs printed full-year 1025 OK; 2016: 202+225+190+118=735 vs printed full-year 735 OK; 2017: 67+95+62+108=332 vs printed full-year 332 OK; 2009: 126+157+192+220=695 vs the FY 2009 prior-year column 695 in the Q4 2010 summary table (2009Q1 is itself derived from H1 2009).
